# Advertising-Blueprint-<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>The Advertising Campaign Blueprint | Beginner's Guide to Planning Ads</title>
<meta name="description" content="A 22-page beginner's guide with worksheets for planning an advertising campaign: objectives, audience, competitors, budget, creative, Facebook and Instagram setup, tracking and evaluation. Includes 5 bonuses. ₦2,990.">
<meta property="og:title" content="The Advertising Campaign Blueprint">
<meta property="og:description" content="Plan the campaign before you pay for the ads. Beginner's guide plus 5 bonus templates, ₦2,990.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0A1430">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bodoni+Moda:opsz,wght@6..96,500;6..96,600;6..96,700&family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --navy:#0A1430; --navy-2:#11224D; --navy-3:#1B2F66;
  --gold:#D4AF55; --gold-soft:#E8D299; --gold-deep:#8A6A1F;
  --ink:#1A2340; --muted:#56607C; --mist:#F3F5FA; --line:#DDE2EE; --white:#fff;
  --display:"Bodoni Moda","Didot","Playfair Display",Georgia,serif;
  --body:"Figtree",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{font-family:var(--body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink);background:var(--white);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{width:min(1120px,100% - 40px);margin-inline:auto}
.narrow{width:min(760px,100% - 40px);margin-inline:auto}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.01em}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,5vw,3rem);margin-bottom:.6em}
h3{font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.25}
section{padding:clamp(56px,9vw,104px) 0}
.lead{font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:60ch}

/* Buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.6em;background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy);font:700 1.05rem/1 var(--body);padding:1.15em 1.9em;border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 10px 30px -10px rgba(212,175,85,.7);transition:transform .15s ease,background .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease}
.btn:hover{background:#E0BE6B;transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 16px 34px -12px rgba(212,175,85,.9)}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(0)}
.btn.lg{font-size:1.15rem;padding:1.25em 2.2em}
.btn.block{width:100%}
.price-tag{font-weight:600;opacity:.85;border-left:1px solid rgba(10,20,48,.3);padding-left:.7em}

/* Top bar */
.top{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;z-index:5;padding:18px 0}
.top .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.brand{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;color:var(--white);text-decoration:none;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.01em}
.top a.mini{color:var(--gold-soft);font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(232,210,153,.4)}

/* Hero */
.hero{background:radial-gradient(1000px 600px at 85% 30%,#1c3270 0%,transparent 60%),linear-gradient(180deg,var(--navy) 0%,#0c1a42 100%);color:var(--white);padding:110px 0 80px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero-grid{display:grid;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.5rem,8.2vw,4.9rem);font-weight:600;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:.4em}
.hero .sub{font-size:clamp(1.05rem,2.6vw,1.3rem);color:#C9D2EA;max-width:34em;margin-bottom:1.6em}
.hero-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px 22px;align-items:center}
.hero-note{color:#9FB0D8;font-size:.95rem}
.value-line{margin-top:30px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid rgba(232,210,153,.25);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 28px;color:var(--gold-soft);font-weight:600;font-size:.98rem}
.value-line span::before{content:"✓";margin-right:.5em;color:var(--gold)}
.book-stage{perspective:1400px;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:10px 0 20px}
.book{position:relative;width:min(340px,76vw);transform:rotateY(-16deg) rotateX(3deg);transform-style:preserve-3d;animation:bookIn 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;transition:transform .5s ease}
.book:hover{transform:rotateY(-6deg) rotateX(1deg)}
.book img{width:100%;border-radius:3px 8px 8px 3px;box-shadow:-18px 30px 60px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.65),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.book::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:14px;border-radius:3px 0 0 3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.45),rgba(255,255,255,.12) 60%,transparent);z-index:2;pointer-events:none}
.book::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:8%;right:8%;bottom:-34px;height:26px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(0,0,0,.5),transparent 70%);filter:blur(6px);z-index:-1}
@keyframes bookIn{from{opacity:0;transform:rotateY(-40deg) translateY(30px)}to{opacity:1;transform:rotateY(-16deg) rotateX(3deg)}}
.book-badge{position:absolute;right:-14px;top:-14px;z-index:3;background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy);font-weight:700;font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.15;text-align:center;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:50%;width:84px;height:84px;display:grid;place-content:center;box-shadow:0 10px 24px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.book-badge b{font-size:1.2rem;display:block}

/* Problem */
.problem{background:var(--mist)}
.problem ul{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:0;margin-top:36px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.problem li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:34px 1fr;gap:14px;padding:22px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.problem li::before{content:"×";font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.7rem;line-height:1;color:#B3402F;font-weight:600}
.problem li strong{display:block;font-size:1.08rem;margin-bottom:2px}
.problem li span{color:var(--muted)}
.problem .turn{margin-top:36px;font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3.4vw,1.9rem);line-height:1.25;color:var(--navy)}

/* Solution */
.solution-grid{display:grid;gap:44px;align-items:center}
.calc{background:var(--navy);color:var(--white);border-radius:18px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(10,20,48,.7);border:1px solid var(--navy-3)}
.calc h3{font-family:var(--body);font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:4px}
.calc small{color:#9FB0D8;display:block;margin-bottom:20px}
.calc label{display:block;font-size:.9rem;color:#C9D2EA;margin:14px 0 6px;font-weight:500}
.calc input{width:100%;background:var(--navy-2);border:1px solid var(--navy-3);color:var(--white);font:600 1.15rem var(--body);padding:.75em .9em;border-radius:10px}
.calc input:focus-visible{outline-color:var(--gold)}
.calc .out{margin-top:22px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px dashed rgba(232,210,153,.4);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.calc .out span{color:#C9D2EA;font-size:.95rem}
.calc .out strong{font-family:var(--display);font-size:2rem;color:var(--gold)}
.calc .fine{margin-top:14px;font-size:.82rem;color:#9FB0D8}

/* Learn */
.learn{background:var(--navy);color:var(--white)}
.learn h2{color:var(--white)}
.learn .lead{color:#C9D2EA}
.toc{list-style:none;counter-reset:ch;margin-top:40px;display:grid;gap:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(232,210,153,.25)}
.toc li{counter-increment:ch;display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr;gap:6px 14px;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(232,210,153,.25)}
.toc li::before{content:counter(ch);font-family:var(--display);font-size:2rem;line-height:1;color:var(--gold)}
.toc h3{color:var(--white);font-family:var(--body);font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem}
.toc p{color:#B5C0DE;font-size:.98rem;grid-column:2}

/* Who */
.who-grid{display:grid;gap:0;margin-top:34px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.who-grid div{padding:22px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.who-grid h3{font-family:var(--body);font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:4px;color:var(--navy)}
.who-grid p{color:var(--muted)}
.who-note{margin-top:28px;background:var(--mist);border-left:4px solid var(--gold);padding:18px 22px;border-radius:0 12px 12px 0}

/* Benefits */
.benefits{background:var(--mist)}
.ben-grid{display:grid;gap:34px;margin-top:38px}
.ben h3{margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--navy);font-size:1.45rem}
.ben p{color:var(--muted)}
.ben{padding-top:18px;border-top:3px solid var(--gold)}
.honest{margin-top:44px;padding:26px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--white);border-radius:16px}
.honest h3{font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--navy)}
.honest p{color:var(--muted)}

/* Bonuses */
.bonus-list{list-style:none;margin-top:36px;display:grid;gap:14px}
.bonus-list li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:6px 18px;align-items:center;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 20px}
.bonus-list .tag{grid-row:span 2;background:var(--navy);color:var(--gold);font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;text-align:center;min-width:76px;line-height:1.1}
.bonus-list strong{font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--navy)}
.bonus-list span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.bonus-total{margin-top:22px;color:var(--gold-deep);font-weight:700}

/* Preview */
.preview{background:var(--navy);color:var(--white)}
.preview h2{color:var(--white)}
.preview .lead{color:#C9D2EA}
.shots{display:grid;gap:26px;margin-top:40px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));align-items:start}
.shot{background:none;border:0;color:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:zoom-in;font:inherit}
.shot img{width:100%;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 24px 50px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.7);transition:transform .2s ease}
.shot:hover img{transform:translateY(-4px)}
.shot figcaption,.shot span{display:block;margin-top:12px;color:var(--gold-soft);font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem}
.shot span small{display:block;color:#9FB0D8;font-weight:400}
dialog{border:0;background:transparent;max-width:min(96vw,720px);width:100%;margin:auto;padding:0}
dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(5,10,28,.88)}
dialog img{width:100%;max-height:88vh;object-fit:contain;border-radius:10px;background:#fff}
dialog button{position:absolute;top:-6px;right:-2px;transform:translateY(-100%);background:var(--gold);border:0;color:var(--navy);font-weight:700;padding:.5em 1em;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer}

/* Final CTA */
.final{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0,#fff 0),var(--white);text-align:center}
.offer{background:radial-gradient(700px 360px at 50% 0%,#1e3573 0%,transparent 70%),var(--navy);color:var(--white);border-radius:28px;padding:clamp(34px,7vw,72px) clamp(22px,5vw,60px);box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(10,20,48,.8)}
.offer h2{color:var(--white);margin-inline:auto;max-width:16em}
.offer .lead{color:#C9D2EA;margin:0 auto 26px}
.offer ul{list-style:none;display:inline-grid;gap:10px;text-align:left;margin:4px 0 30px;color:#E4EAF8}
.offer li::before{content:"✓";color:var(--gold);margin-right:.7em;font-weight:700}
.offer .price{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(3rem,10vw,4.6rem);color:var(--gold);line-height:1;margin-bottom:6px}
.offer .price small{font-family:var(--body);font-size:1rem;color:#9FB0D8;display:block;margin-top:8px}
.offer .btn{margin-top:6px}
.secure{margin-top:18px;color:#9FB0D8;font-size:.9rem}

/* FAQ */
.faq details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.faq details:first-of-type{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.faq summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;padding:22px 40px 22px 0;font-weight:700;font-size:1.08rem;color:var(--navy);position:relative}
.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.faq summary::after{content:"+";position:absolute;right:4px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:1.6rem;color:var(--gold-deep);transition:transform .25s ease}
.faq details[open] summary::after{transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(45deg)}
.faq details p{padding:0 0 24px;color:var(--muted);max-width:62ch}

/* Footer */
footer{background:var(--navy);color:#9FB0D8;padding:44px 0 110px;font-size:.9rem}
footer .wrap{display:grid;gap:12px}
footer strong{font-family:var(--display);color:var(--white);font-size:1.1rem}

/* Sticky bar */
.sticky{position:fixed;inset:auto 0 0 0;z-index:20;background:rgba(10,20,48,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-top:1px solid rgba(232,210,153,.3);padding:10px 16px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;transform:translateY(110%);transition:transform .3s ease}
.sticky.show{transform:none}
.sticky p{color:var(--white);font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;font-size:.95rem}
.sticky p small{display:block;color:var(--gold-soft);font-weight:500}
.sticky .btn{padding:.95em 1.4em;font-size:.98rem;white-space:nowrap}

@media (min-width:820px){
  .hero{padding:140px 0 110px}
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr}
  .solution-grid{grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr}
  .who-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:56px}
  .ben-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:44px 56px}
  .toc{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:56px}
  .problem ul{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:56px}
  .sticky{display:none}
  footer{padding-bottom:44px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  .book{animation:none;transform:rotateY(-16deg) rotateX(3deg)}
  *{transition:none!important}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="top">
  <div class="wrap">
    <a class="brand" href="#top">The Advertising Campaign Blueprint</a>
    <a class="mini" href="https://selar.com/83hi684175" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Buy now</a>
  </div>
</header>

<main id="top">

<!-- 1. HERO -->
<section class="hero" id="hero">
  <div class="wrap hero-grid">
    <div>
      <h1>Plan the campaign before you pay for the ads.</h1>
      <p class="sub">A beginner-friendly, 22-page guide with fill-in worksheets. It walks you from objective to audience, budget, creative and tracking, so every naira you put into Facebook and Instagram ads has a reason behind it.</p>
      <div class="hero-cta">
        <a class="btn lg" href="https://selar.com/83hi684175" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-buy>Get Your Copy Now <span class="price-tag">₦2,990</span></a>
        <span class="hero-note">Digital PDF, delivered through Selar</span>
      </div>
      <div class="value-line">
        <span>Practical worksheets</span>
        <span>Written for beginners</span>
        <span>5 bonus templates included</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="book-stage">
      <div class="book">
        <div class="book-badge"><div><b>5</b>free bonuses</div></div>
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Cover of The Advertising Campaign Blueprint, Beginner's Guide by Victor Richard" width="640" height="843" fetchpriority="high">
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 2. PROBLEM -->
<section class="problem">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2>Most ad budgets are wasted before the ad goes live.</h2>
    <p class="lead">Boosting a post is easy. Running a campaign that makes sense for your business is harder. These are the problems the Blueprint is built to fix.</p>
    <ul>
      <li><div><strong>Running ads without a clear strategy</strong><span>You launch because everyone else is advertising, with no plan for what the ad should achieve.</span></div></li>
      <li><div><strong>Spending without a campaign objective</strong><span>Awareness, traffic, leads and sales need different setups. Mixing them up burns money.</span></div></li>
      <li><div><strong>Targeting the wrong audience</strong><span>Reaching people who will never buy is the most expensive kind of reach.</span></div></li>
      <li><div><strong>Creating ads on the fly</strong><span>Without a message, offer and creative plan, every ad becomes a guess.</span></div></li>
      <li><div><strong>Not understanding the metrics</strong><span>CPC, CTR, CPM, conversions and ROAS look like jargon until someone explains them plainly.</span></div></li>
      <li><div><strong>Struggling to measure performance</strong><span>If you can't tell what worked, you can't repeat it or stop paying for what didn't.</span></div></li>
    </ul>
    <p class="turn">Good campaigns start on paper. That's where this guide begins.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 3. SOLUTION -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap solution-grid">
    <div>
      <h2>One guide that turns ad ideas into a written plan.</h2>
      <p class="lead" style="margin-bottom:1em">The Advertising Campaign Blueprint is a practical planner for organising, structuring and evaluating your advertising. Each chapter explains one decision in plain language, then gives you a worksheet to make it for your own business.</p>
      <p class="lead" style="margin-bottom:1.6em">It's honest by design. It teaches you to plan with real numbers and treats budgets as the cost of learning, not a promise of sales.</p>
      <a class="btn" href="https://selar.com/83hi684175" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-buy>Get Your Copy Now</a>
    </div>
    <div class="calc" aria-labelledby="calc-title">
      <h3 id="calc-title">Try the budget formula from Chapter 5</h3>
      <small>Planned media spend = average daily budget × number of days</small>
      <label for="daily">Daily budget (₦)</label>
      <input id="daily" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="0" value="3000">
      <label for="days">Campaign length (days)</label>
      <input id="days" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="0" value="14">
      <div class="out"><span>Planned media budget</span><strong id="total" aria-live="polite">₦42,000</strong></div>
      <p class="fine">A planning estimate, not a forecast of clicks, leads or sales. The guide shows you what to do next.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 4. WHAT YOU WILL LEARN -->
<section class="learn">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2>What's inside the Blueprint</h2>
    <p class="lead">Nine areas, taken in the order you'd plan a real campaign.</p>
    <ol class="toc">
      <li><h3>Business and product overview</h3><p>Get clear on what you sell, to whom, and why it matters before you advertise it.</p></li>
      <li><h3>Campaign objectives</h3><p>Choose between awareness, traffic, leads and sales, and write a SMART objective.</p></li>
      <li><h3>Audience research</h3><p>Define who you want to reach so your targeting isn't a guess.</p></li>
      <li><h3>Competitor analysis</h3><p>Study what others offer and say, then find a point of difference you can support.</p></li>
      <li><h3>Advertising budget</h3><p>Set total and daily budgets, split spend sensibly and understand contribution profit.</p></li>
      <li><h3>Content and creative strategy</h3><p>Plan your message, formats and creative before you design or record anything.</p></li>
      <li><h3>Facebook and Instagram campaign planning</h3><p>Lay out your campaign structure so setup is a matter of filling in the blanks.</p></li>
      <li><h3>Performance tracking</h3><p>Understand CPC, CTR, CPM, conversions and ROAS, and know what each one tells you.</p></li>
      <li><h3>Campaign evaluation</h3><p>Review results honestly and decide what to keep, change or stop.</p></li>
    </ol>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 5. WHO -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2>Who this eBook is for</h2>
    <p class="lead">If you're spending, or about to spend, money on ads and want a clearer process, it's for you.</p>
    <div class="who-grid">
